details.report: Review refused for method failure. The mandated one parallel Agent batch ran after the successful fixed-point preflight, but the Standards child breached its explicit authority isolation by inspecting and using README despite being restricted to `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/adr/0016-tests-follow-logic-not-format.md`. Aggregation cannot cure a child-method breach, and the task expressly forbids any later Agent rerun. Therefore no compliant completed review can be submitted.
